jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description: Business Development Manager – New Business & Business Development Location: North London, Hertfordshire & Essex Salary: £35-38k basic salary + highly competitive commission structure (OTE circa £55-65k) Package: Excellent company benefits including Company Car, Pension, Life Cover, & many more. Are you a proven B2B sales professional who genuinely enjoys winning new business? We’re looking for an Area Sales Manager to take ownership of a defined territory and drive growth through a predominantly new-business-focused sales role. You’ll be responsible for introducing our clients comprehensive maintenance and service solution for the upkeep/repair of capital equipment that is crucial to the smooth and successful running of their operations. These organisations will be those where reliability, service and long-term partnership really matter. Your target market will include hospitals and healthcare organisations, care homes, universities, schools, prisons and selected hotel groups. While there is an expectation for you to self generate some of your new leads, you will also have the robust support of an internal team who will identify, qualify and pass potential new opportunities for you to investigate and convert, and the majority of your meetings will be pre-booked for you, leaving you time to complete various admin tasks, follow up on quotes submitted and close business! This is a role for someone who enjoys the hunt – identifying opportunities, opening doors, building relationships with decision-makers and ultimately winning the business. Once you’ve won a customer, you’ll retain responsibility for that relationship, with the role gradually developing to include more account management, retention and growth. However, new business will always remain a significant part of the role, so a genuine appetite for winning new customers is essential. The role You’ll be expected to: Identify and follow up on new business opportunities across your territory Build relationships with decision-makers across healthcare, education, public sector, care and hospitality Proactively prospect and generate your own opportunities as well as inbound leads Manage the full sales cycle, from initial contact through to negotiation and close Understand customer challenges and position a solution around their needs Navigate complex organisations and multiple stakeholders Win new contracts and develop those relationships over the long term Take increasing responsibility for account management, retention and further growth Identify opportunities to expand relationships within existing customers Manage your own diary, territory and pipeline with a high degree of autonomy Consistently deliver against ambitious new-business and revenue targets What we’re looking for This role will suit someone who has a proven and consistent track record in B2B field sales, particularly someone who has demonstrated the ability to build a territory and deliver new-business growth over a sustained period. You’ll need to be a hunter by nature. Someone who enjoys prospecting, isn’t afraid to pick up the phone, can open doors and gets genuine satisfaction from turning a cold opportunity into a new customer. You’ll also need to demonstrate an understanding that winning the customer is only the beginning. You’ll be responsible for building a relationship that lasts, understanding the customer’s operation and identifying opportunities to grow the account over time. We’re particularly interested in people who can demonstrate: A strong track record of B2B new-business sales Consistent performance and progression throughout their career The resilience and determination required to operate in a target-driven environment Experience selling maintenance/service solutions or services Having sold capex into one of the previously mentioned routes to market would also be a great fit, especially if there is the opportunity to sell a service or maintenance contract alongside The ability to sell into complex or multi-stakeholder organisations Strong commercial awareness and negotiation skills Excellent relationship-building and communication skills The ability to operate autonomously and manage a territory effectively A genuine desire to win new business – you should enjoy the chase A stable career history and evidence of building long-term relationships with customers and employers What is on offer Basic Salary – £35k-£38k DOE + competitive commission structure (OTE circa £55-£65k) Company Car – EV options only Life insurance, Company Pension & Access to a Well-Being app which gives you access to dental care & similar 25 days holiday + Bank Holidays

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description: Account Executive – Automotive Sector (SaaS & Market Intelligence) UK | Hybrid (London) £50,000 basic + £20,000-£25,000 OTE A global provider of market intelligence and advisory solutions is expanding its UK commercial team and is looking to hire an Account Executive to drive growth within the automotive sector. This is a high‑impact role focused on selling data, insights and consulting services to senior stakeholders across manufacturers, OEMs and supply chain organisations. The organisation works with some of the world’s largest companies, helping them make strategic decisions through market insight, data and emerging technology platforms. The Company This business is a globally recognised market research and advisory firm, delivering in‑depth industry intelligence and consulting services to organisations across multiple sectors. With thousands of clients worldwide-including a significant proportion of global enterprise organisations-the company has built a strong reputation for delivering high‑quality, data‑led insights. It is also investing in next‑generation technology platforms that allow clients to access and analyse large volumes of research in real time. With a growing UK presence and continued global expansion, the organisation operates at the forefront of the market intelligence space. The Opportunity This role focuses on selling subscription‑based research, consulting services and access to an advanced data platform into the automotive sector. You will manage a full sales cycle, from prospecting through to closing, engaging senior stakeholders across strategy, operations and R&D functions. Sales cycles typically range from 6-8 weeks, with deal values spanning from approximately $35,000 up to $200,000. With support from marketing and international business development teams, alongside a strong product offering and brand credibility, this is an opportunity to build a significant revenue stream within a high‑value vertical. What You’ll Be Doing Selling market intelligence subscriptions, research reports and consulting services Generating new business through outbound activity and self‑sourcing Running discovery calls, product demonstrations and presentations Engaging senior stakeholders across strategy, operations and R&D Managing full sales cycles through to negotiation and close Building and maintaining a strong pipeline within the automotive sector What They’re Looking For Experience Requirements: 3-7 years of B2B sales experience, ideally within SaaS, data or subscription‑based services Experience selling into the automotive sector is advantageous Strong background in new business acquisition and full sales cycle management Comfortable with outbound selling, demos and closing Character: Driven, confident and commercially focused Self‑starter with high levels of autonomy Strong communication and presentation skills Sense of urgency and ability to work in a fast‑paced environment Package £50,000 basic salary £20,000-£25,000 OTE (paid quarterly) Hybrid working – 1-2 days per week in London office Mobile, laptop and home working setup Pension and healthcare 25 days holiday + bank holidays

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description: * Field based sales role covering Wales within the veterinary sector * Work with a broad portfolio of veterinary pharmaceuticals, consumables, pet food and equipment * Join a collaborative, high-performing team with strong market presence and recognised products Customer Relationship Manager The Role: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Customer Relationship Manager to join a well-established organisation operating within the veterinary products market. The Customer Relationship Manager will be responsible for developing and strengthening relationships with veterinary practices across Wales while driving sales across a wide range of veterinary products including pharmaceuticals, consumables, pet food and equipment. In this role, the Customer Relationship Manager will focus on both generating new business opportunities and managing existing accounts. You will engage with a variety of stakeholders including veterinary practice owners, practice managers, veterinary nurses, reception teams, and local animal health groups and societies. The position requires a proactive and consultative approach, identifying customer needs and presenting appropriate solutions from a comprehensive product portfolio. As a Customer Relationship Manager , you will play an important part in expanding market presence while maintaining long-term partnerships within the veterinary community. Requirements: To be considered for the Customer Relationship Manager role: * Field based sales experience, ideally within consumables or a related sector * Proven ability to generate new business while managing existing accounts * Strong relationship building and communication skills * Self-motivated with the ability to manage a regional territory effectively The Culture: This is a close-knit and collaborative environment where teamwork and cross-department support are highly valued. The business is known for maintaining high standards and delivering quality products, with teams working together to achieve strong results in a competitive market. The Package for Customer Relationship Manager: * Basic salary £35,000 – £45,000 * £12,500 OTE * £6,000 car allowance or salary sacrifice car scheme * 25 days annual leave + bank holidays + birthday leave The Company: A leading manufacturer and supplier of high-quality veterinary products, consumables and equipment. The organisation offers a broad product portfolio ranging from pharmaceuticals to specialist equipment, supported by national distribution hubs ensuring reliable delivery and service. Headquartered in Scotland and part of a global animal health technology group, the business has an established international presence and strong reputation within the veterinary sector. Location: Wales (field based)
